name: Tucker Craig
intro: Hello, world! I'm Tucker. A lot of what I build starts with something small that bugs me. I wanted to keep track of my AI usage, so I built a tracker. I didn't want to keep paying for voice-to-text, so I made my own. I wanted my AI agents with me, so now they're on my phone. Even something to help me get the right movie seat. There's a bunch more in my project page, feel free to check it out.
personal: I also sang acapella in The Nuances at Davidson.
currentWork: I’m writing the firmware for an arduino I’m calling omalo, a pocket companion. My current work brings Pokémon Emerald to the device, with an AI handoff for gameplay goals.
